successCriteria.description: `PgBalanceRepository` implements every method of `IBalanceRepository` (`findByEmployeeId`, `findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType`, `findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear`, `create`, `update`, `deductDays`) using parameterized SQL queries against the pg `Pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, with snake_case↔camelCase column mapping.

`PgBalanceRepository.deductDays(id, days)` atomically decrements `remaining_days` by `days`, increments `used_days` by `days`, and sets `status` to `'exhausted'` when `remaining_days` reaches 0 — all within a single UPDATE returning the updated row. If no row matches `id`, it throws `BalanceNotFoundError`.

`BalanceService` implements `IBalanceService`: `getBalance` delegates to `IBalanceRepository.findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType` and throws `BalanceNotFoundError` when the repository returns null; `hasSufficientBalance` returns `true` iff `remainingDays >= requestedDays`; `deductBalance` delegates to `IBalanceRepository.deductDays`.

`PgAuditLogRepository` implements every method of `IAuditLogRepository` (`findByEntity`, `create`, `findAll` with optional filters) using parameterized SQL queries against the pg `Pool`, with snake_case↔camelCase column mapping.

Jest unit tests exist for `PgBalanceRepository` (mocking pg `Pool`), `BalanceService` (mocking `IBalanceRepository`), and `PgAuditLogRepository` (mocking pg `Pool`), covering all methods including the `deductDays` exhaustion transition and the `BalanceNotFoundError` throw path.

A balance controller exposes `getBalance(employeeId, leaveType)` and `getBalances(employeeId)` operations, each delegating to `IBalanceService` and returning the result as a JSON response. RBAC is enforced: employees may only access their own balances; managers may access balances of their direct reports; hr_admin may access any balance.
Balance routes are registered as a Fastify plugin and wired into `src/app.ts` alongside the existing `uptimeRoutes`, making the balance endpoints available at runtime.

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer — no inline SQL or pg Pool usage in services, controllers, or routes (GP-001).
All state-changing operations (create, update, deductDays on Balance; create on AuditLog) must write an audit record via `IAuditLogRepository` (GP-002).

Balance state-changing operations (`deductBalance`) must be callable within a caller-owned transaction — the repository's `deductDays` must accept an optional `pg.PoolClient` parameter so the orchestrator (leave-request service) can pass a transaction client for atomic audit+deduct commits.
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards where needed (HARNESS constraint `no-any`).
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks — all return types must match the interface declarations exactly.
outOfScope: Day-counting calculation (calendar days inclusive). The binding rule in the reconciled architecture states the calculation lives in the leave-request module. Balance module only accepts the pre-calculated day count.

Balance restoration on leave cancellation — the `IBalanceRepository` does not need a `restoreDays` method in this phase. Restoration logic belongs to the leave-request module (Phase 6) and will use the existing `update` method or a future dedicated method.

ambiguities.description: The PLAN.md prescribes a separate `balance.controller.ts` + `balance.routes.ts` split, but the existing codebase only has the `uptime` module which uses a single `uptime.routes.ts` file that instantiates the service inline (no separate controller). The code agent must decide whether to follow the PLAN.md prescription (controller + routes split) or the existing uptime pattern (single routes file). Either is acceptable as long as the interface contracts are satisfied.
options: Follow existing uptime pattern: single balance.routes.ts that instantiates BalanceService inline

ambiguities.description: The architecture specifies RBAC enforcement via `requireRole(...)` middleware and JWT auth populating `request.user`, but no auth middleware exists in the codebase yet. The balance controller must enforce that employees can only access their own balances, managers can access direct reports' balances, and hr_admin can access any balance — but the mechanism for this (middleware, inline check, or deferred) is unclear given the missing infrastructure.
options: Implement inline RBAC checks in the controller using a request.user pattern (assuming auth middleware will be added later)
Defer RBAC enforcement to a future phase and document the gap
Create a minimal requireRole middleware as part of this phase

entityInvariants.invariant: `remainingDays` must always equal `totalEntitlement - usedDays`. Any mutation to `usedDays` (via `deductDays`) must update `remainingDays` in the same atomic operation. When `remainingDays` reaches 0, `status` must transition to `BalanceStatus.exhausted`.

Every `AuditLog` record must have a non-empty `entityType`, `entityId`, `action`, and `performedBy`. The `changes` field must be a plain object (not an array, not null) — it captures the before/after diff of the state change.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws `BalanceNotFoundError` (code `NOT_FOUND`) when no balance row matches the given `id`. Throws `InsufficientBalanceError` (code `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`) when `remainingDays < days`. Returns the updated `Balance` on success — never returns null.
Throws `BalanceNotFoundError` (code `NOT_FOUND`) when no balance exists for the given employee and leave type. Returns `Balance` on success — never returns null.
Throws `BalanceNotFoundError` when no balance exists for the given employee and leave type. Throws `InsufficientBalanceError` when `remainingDays < days`. Returns the updated `Balance` on success.
Throws `AuditLogValidationError` (code `VALIDATION_ERROR`) when required fields (`entityType`, `entityId`, `action`, `performedBy`) are missing or empty. Returns the created `AuditLog` on success.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `PgBalanceRepository` must follow the same pattern as `PgEmployeeRepository` and `PgLeavePolicyRepository`: import `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, use a `mapRowToBalance` function for snake_case→camelCase conversion, use a `COLUMN_MAP` lookup for dynamic UPDATE SET clause construction, and use parameterized `$1, $2, …` placeholders.

`PgAuditLogRepository` must follow the same pattern as `PgEmployeeRepository`: import `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, use a `mapRowToAuditLog` function for snake_case→camelCase conversion, and use parameterized `$1, $2, …` placeholders.

`BalanceService` must match the pattern of `LeavePolicyService`: stateless class, constructor receives the repository interface, methods delegate to the repository and apply domain logic (throwing typed errors for not-found/invalid states).

The `Balance` entity interface, `IBalanceRepository`, `IBalanceService`, and error classes (`InsufficientBalanceError`, `BalanceNotFoundError`) already exist in `balance.model.ts` and must not be modified — the concrete implementations must satisfy these interfaces exactly as declared.

The `AuditLog` entity interface, `IAuditLogRepository`, and `AuditLogValidationError` already exist in `audit-log.model.ts` and must not be modified — the concrete implementation must satisfy these interfaces exactly as declared.
The `BalanceStatus` enum (`active`, `exhausted`) from `src/shared/types/index.ts` must be used for the `Balance.status` field — no hardcoded string literals.

integrationPoints.why: Both `PgBalanceRepository` and `PgAuditLogRepository` must import the `pool` from this module for all database operations, following the same pattern as `PgEmployeeRepository` and `PgLeavePolicyRepository`.
`BalanceStatus` enum (`active`, `exhausted`) is used by `Balance.status` and must be imported by the balance repository and service for the exhaustion transition logic.
The concrete `PgBalanceRepository`, `BalanceService`, `BalanceController`, and balance routes all import their interfaces and entity types from this file. Must not be modified — only consumed.
The concrete `PgAuditLogRepository` imports `IAuditLogRepository`, `AuditLog`, and `AuditLogValidationError` from this file. Must not be modified — only consumed.
